title: UAE’s new financial law pulls DeFi and Web3 into regulatory scope
summary: Federal Decree Law No. 6 expands the UAE central bank’s authority over DeFi, ending the “just code” defense and imposing penalties of up to $272 million.

title: Pump.fun co-founder denies $436M cash out, claims it was ‘treasury management’
summary: The Pump.fun co-founder disputed claims of a massive off-ramp and said Pump.fun’s USDC shifts were routine treasury operations.

title: Exodus taps Bitcoin holdings to fund $175M move into onchain payments
summary: Exodus is using its Bitcoin reserves to back a $175 million acquisition of W3C Corp, bringing Monavate and Baanx under its roof as it expands into onchain payments.

title: Bitcoin at $87K: BTC buying opportunity or dead cat bounce?
summary: Bitcoin price tools returned to levels last seen several years ago as calls for a BTC price relief rally continued to grow louder.

title: Berachain disputes ‘framing’ of a $25M refund deal to Brevan Howard
summary: Berachain’s founder says a report that it gave one of its Series B investors a year-long refund right on its $25 million investment is both “inaccurate and incomplete.”

title: ‘OG whale’ who called the October crash has a $44.5M long on Ether
summary: The Hyperliquid whale that made $200 million in the October crash has just added another $10 million to its long position on Ether.

title: Crypto VC activity hits $4.6B in Q3, second-best quarter since FTX collapse
summary: Half of the capital raised in the third quarter was from seven venture deals, with Revolut leading the way with a $1 billion investment.

title: Bitcoin’s Sharpe ratio is nearly at zero, a rare risk-reward signal
summary: Bitcoin’s Sharpe ratio has fallen to nearly zero, matching levels from 2019, 2020, and 2022 market bottoms, as 8% of all BTC moved onchain in historic volatility.

title: BitMine, Strategy, SharpLink stocks outpace crypto market recovery
summary: Digital asset treasury stocks surged on Monday, led by BitMine, even outpacing the broader crypto market’s gains as institutional ownership increased.

title: SEC issues ‘rare’ no-action letter for Solana DePIN project token FUSE
summary: It comes several months after the SEC issued a similar no-action letter to DoubleZero, seen as a significant regulatory milestone for DePIN projects.
